title: rosa canina f. hirtistylis
intro: Rosa canina f. hirtistylis, commonly known as the hairy-stemmed dog rose, is a variant of the dog rose plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. hirtistylis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and may provide antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
